_metadata.source: Platts / OilPrice public disclosures + EIA weekly refiner prices
_metadata.note: Published crack-spread values curated from public weekly summaries. Singapore 3-2-1 and Dubai 1-1 are Platts-assessed; RBOB Gasoline and ULSD Heating cracks are computed from NYMEX front-month product prices vs. WTI; NWE Gasoil is ICE Gasoil vs. Brent. Refresh requires either a Platts subscription (Singapore) or a serverless endpoint that pulls EIA weekly PADD3 gasoline + distillate wholesale prices and computes the 3-2-1 against the existing Brent feed.
